ImageDescription.value: St. Anthony's Church, Macau, one of the three oldest churches in that country. This building is a 1930s reconstruction of the original, which was burnt down on 22 Sept. 1874. Every year, on that date, devotees take out a procession carrying the image of St. Anthony. Several Portuguese weddings used to be conducted here as well, once upon a time, due to which this church is also called Fa Vong Tong (in Chinese), meaning Church of Flowers. Jan/ Feb. 2012.
